Contrary to the lies and hype, math is not the universe. Math is not the language of the universe. Math is the language of man used to describe a simulation of the universe. It is separate and distinct from the universe itself. Their willingness to conflate things causes endless problems.

Here's the deal. However the universe works we attempt to describe it. The language of description is math. It may well be the language of description is universal. Maybe. To describe the universe, we actually wind up describing a model (a simulation) of the universe. So math is actually twice removed from reality. An error in the understanding of the simulation causes problems. An error in the description of the simulation causes problems.

This is why just because something can be described and proofed in math doesn't mean it's actually an accurate description of reality. The math can be completely correct. But that doesn't mean the simulation it's describing is an accurate representation of reality. Ideally, both are correct. Meaning an accurate simulation and an accurate description of the simulation. Good science is when they both align.
